create_mock_embedding: create a mock embedding response with a model name and a list of float values
test_mock_embedding: test the mock_embedding function with a model name and mock response list
run_mock_image_generation: run the mock_image_generation function with a model name and image URL
review_mock_embedding: review the mock_embedding function that returns an EmbeddingResponse with usage tokens
summarize_mock_image_generation: summarize the mock_image_generation function that returns an ImageResponse with a URL
